acceptanceCriteria: Different arm case sets, duplicates, missing outcomes, negative/nonfinite token counts and unknown arms cannot yield threshold met.
A treatment-only failure cannot qualify for a savings claim by using fewer tokens.
A valid matched complete-cost fixture meeting the registered thresholds qualifies.
No-observation runs preserve NOT_OBSERVED and no-savings output.
body:
Comprehensive expert audit 2026-09-26, EVAL-02. Audited source 2961076fc0b78bfab743578f2ef5c17006be058a. Evidence classification: confirmed.

Supply --agent-observations whose baseline and treatment rows name different caseIds, omit outcome evidence, or include treatment human failures; make aggregate correctness outcomes PASS. agent_cost ignores caseId and uses all token rows, including unsuccessful tasks, to return savingsClaim='threshold met'. This can promote a selection artifact or early failure as complete-task savings. Current committed run-002 has NOT_OBSERVED costs and is not itself an invalid savings claim.

Source: benchmarks/daily-loop-v0/harness.py:510; docs/specs/proof-carrying-context-optimization-v0.md:105; docs/specs/proof-carrying-context-optimization-v0.md:126

Owning contract/status: "PCCO-V0-012 defines complete cost per solved task; PCCO-V0-017 is explicitly proposed, not accepted, but is the harness's cited cost-claim contract. Existing preregistration requires observed complete task cost in both arms."

Verification: "Executed the exact agent_cost AST function from the pinned source with baseline caseId hard-unmatched, 1000 tokens, humanFailure false and treatment caseId easy-unmatched, 1 token, humanFailure true. With three PASS correctness outcomes, returned savingsClaim='threshold met' and treatment humanFailureRate=1.0. Input and output retained as evaluation-cost-repro.jsonl and evaluation-cost-result.json. No benchmark or model run executed."

Suggested correction: Validate a closed observations schema, bind observations to the registered corpus and run identity, require matched unique case/repetition sets in both arms, and retain failed/ineligible tasks separately. Require confirmed solved-task outcomes and non-inferior correctness before any savings label; malformed or incomplete observations must fail closed or remain no-claim.

Report: .agent-evidence/2026-09-26-comprehensive-audit.md; retained expert and reproduction evidence in .agent-evidence/audit-20260926/. Run focused regressions and owning documentation checks; exhaustive gate only when governing release policy requires it. No implementation, intent acceptance or promotion is claimed.
title: Daily-loop cost gate accepts unmatched and failed task observations as savings
